scope: Minimal N=4 time-domain Fourier-micromotion feasibility test for the Floquet-manifold reduction. It is not a topological control, a Sambe density-matrix formalism, or a larger-system result.
motivation: Gate B2 showed that an initial-support-compatible static B^(0)-only K=16 reduction remains quantitatively inaccurate. Gate C1 tests whether retaining nonzero Fourier harmonics of B(t) materially repairs the error before scaling N.

common_readout.phasor: A_TLS=|2/(t_f-t_dis) integral[c_d(t)-mean(c_d)] exp(+i Omega t/2) dt|

basis_and_initial_projection.local_near_pi_pair: At m=0, select the maximum local B^(0) pair among circular pi mismatch <=0.02 rad; mechanism anchor only.
basis_and_initial_projection.initial_support_order: Descending |<phi_a|up_z^{tensor N}>|^2, exact ties resolved by ascending numerical Schur index.
basis_and_initial_projection.hybrid_rule: Begin with the local near-pi pair and append initial-support states excluding existing entries until K is reached.
basis_and_initial_projection.K_rule: Use the smallest K in [4,6,8] whose hybrid p_K>=0.90. If none qualifies, stop without dynamic reduction.
basis_and_initial_projection.projection: For every reduced calculation c_K=P_K|up_z^{tensor N}>/sqrt(p_K), with undefined status if p_K<=1e-12.

reduced_models.static_M0: H_K uses B^(0) only, reproducing the existing static reduction.
reduced_models.Fourier_M1: Use B_M(t)=sum_{n=-1}^{1} B^(n) exp(+in Omega t) in the time-dependent K-state Lindblad Hamiltonian.
reduced_models.Fourier_M2: Use B_M(t)=sum_{n=-2}^{2} B^(n) exp(+in Omega t).
reduced_models.full_micromotion: Use exact piecewise B(t)=<u_a(t)|sigma_m^-|u_b(t)> evaluated at propagation midpoints. This is the within-K micromotion reference.
reduced_models.sambe_statement: The M=1 and M=2 reconstructions are a time-domain Fourier realization of a Floquet/Sambe harmonic truncation. No claim is made that a density matrix in replica space is itself a physical Sambe observable.

prospective_decision.failure: Do not scale this reduction to N=6. Report whether the obstruction is harmonic truncation (M1 differs materially from full micromotion) or finite-manifold/other approximation (full micromotion remains inaccurate).

provenance_requirements.before_run: Publicly commit this protocol and executable script. Each result records protocol/script/source SHA-256, Git commit, UTC timestamps and exact command.
provenance_requirements.language: prospectively frozen numerical protocol; not preregistration absent an external timestamp.
